name: Reading Sheet Music for Guitar
equipment: A guitar and sheet music or tab (optional)
instructions: Most guitarists start with tablature (tab) -- a simplified notation showing which string and fret to play, rather than standard notation.
Standard notation (the staff with notes) is useful longer-term for reading music shared across instruments.
You do not need to master either to keep playing and enjoying guitar, but recognizing basic tab will help you learn new songs faster.
Watch today's video for an introduction to reading sheet music.
